Good Indian Food!
Oct 2025 • Couples
This was our 9th day in Vietnam, we had been eating only at Vietnamese restaurants but Aalishan's was right across from our restaurant and we decided to go in and give it a try, I'm glad that we did.

We took a seat and menus were brought right over. We ordered some of our favorite dishes. 

The food arrived and it looked great and it tasted as good as it looked!

The two ladies that were serving us were very friendly and a joy to talk to. The restaurant looked clean and cozy.

If you happen to be in Hanoi and are looking for good Indian food I recommend that you visit Aalishan's.
